name: Caps
summary: The fleet quota Caps already tracks, on the shelf
description: Caps reads /Users/lee/CC/Work/LFI/_ Operations/menubar-snapshot.json, the same file Caps' menu-bar app and its Bartender line read, plus Codex's own session logs. It shows the fleet percentage as a small ring beside the notch, and a shelf card with one bar per account on one scale: 7-day use, the budget cap as a notch on the bar, 5-hour use, and Codex's weekly use. Spent accounts keep their place and say when they are back. Hover the card to see every reset time. Read-only, local files, no network, refreshed about once a minute.
